topic.title: A task, read as a conversation
topic.shortdesc: Opening a task shows it as the conversation it is: what was asked or came in, each answer with the actions it led to, each reply, and a box to carry it on.

image.alt: A task page: the email that came in, the assistant's answer with the order as a card, the reply that changed its draft, and the reply box.

body.p: You get here from Activity, the Inbox, a notification, a chat answer's status, or Pick up where you left off in Chat. Back returns to where you were. The top shows who has it and how it stands: Working on it, Waiting for your approval, Done, Didn't finish, Stopped or Held by the daily budget.

dlentry.dd: Your own message, or what came in. An email shows its sender, date and attachments; automated mail is folded away (Show it).

What the assistant said, with any records as cards. Everything it did to get there is one line above the answer: while it works the line says what it is doing now; afterwards it says how many steps it took and where (4 steps: Odoo, Brain). The line is folded; open it to see every call, what came back and the notes it made along the way.

Under the answer that proposed them. One waiting for you is shown in full, to approve, reject, edit or ask for changes, exactly as in Approvals. Decided ones fold into a line that says how they went (2 actions done, 1 failed).
Each reply you sent, followed by what came back. A specialist's report to the assistant shows as Report back from …, folded.
While it is working, stops it and any work it handed on. It then shows as Stopped; reply to carry on, or try it again.
Something that didn't finish can be tried again; the reason it failed is shown above the button. A task held by a budget can be run now, ignoring the daily budget for this one run.

The workings, folded at the bottom: who handled it, where it came from, how it was sorted, each run with its cost, the task's id, the read-aloud switch, and the Handover note: the goal, what has been decided and done, what is open, and the order numbers, files and links involved, which every later run starts from.
The same request for the same business within a few minutes is linked to the first task instead of running again. Open the original goes there.

body.p: When a task has answered (it is done, didn't finish, or is waiting for approval), the box under the conversation carries it on: answer its question, change the plan, or ask for something else. The task runs again with your reply and its earlier work, and your reply shows in the conversation straight away. While it is still working there is no box: reply as soon as it has answered. Enter sends; Shift+Enter starts a new line; the microphone dictates.
